title: Sample Drift Correction Following 4D Confocal Time-lapse Imaging
protocol: Set the sampling rate for temporal resolution of dynamic events.
Ensure time between image time-points is at least half the interval of regular repeating events.
Decrease time intervals for irregular events to capture dynamics accurately.
Load acquired dataset using LOCI Bio-Formats Importer plugin.
Select "Use virtual stack option" if dataset exceeds allocated memory.
Correct drift of 3D object in post processing.
Run the Correct 3D drift plugin once the dataset has loaded.
Select the channel representing a static structure within the sample for registration, or choose the channel with the least movement if necessary.
If available RAM is less than twice the size of the original dataset, select the use virtual stack option to store registered hyperstack as an image sequence.
Select a folder for the plugin to output individual corrected images files.
